description.en: Larisa is a store dashboard for online shops, retail, UMKM, and F&B businesses: track sales and best sellers, read traffic and funnel analytics, segment customers, answer messages and reviews, and connect sales channels.
description.id: Larisa adalah dashboard toko untuk toko online, ritel, UMKM, dan bisnis F&B: pantau penjualan dan produk terlaris, baca analitik trafik dan funnel, kelompokkan pelanggan, balas pesan dan ulasan, serta hubungkan kanal penjualan.
